title: Freelance Web Design Quote Template
description: Create a free web design quote PDF with common project line items already filled in. Edit rates, tax, and branding in the browser — no sign-up.

faq.question: Can I change the web design line items?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the editor from this page and every field is editable — descriptions, quantities, rates, tax, and notes.

faq.question: Is this web design quote template free?
faq.answer: Yes. Unlimited quotes and searchable PDF export are free. Pro unlocks logo, brand colour, and studio templates for a one-time fee.

faq.question: Does my client data leave the browser?
faq.answer: No. MakeFastQuote runs entirely client-side. Documents are not uploaded to a server.

title: Graphic Design Quote Template
description: Send a polished graphic design quote PDF in minutes. Preloaded branding and packaging items you can customize before download.

faq.question: Is a quote the same as a proposal here?
faq.answer: You can switch between quote, price estimate, proposal, and proforma in the editor. None of these is a tax invoice.

faq.question: Can I add print or packaging fees?
faq.answer: Yes. Add line items for printing, mockups, or rush fees before you export the PDF.

faq.question: Will the PDF text be selectable?
faq.answer: Yes. Exports are real A4 text PDFs, not scanned images, so clients can copy bank details.

title: Photography Quote Template
description: Free photography quote generator with session, editing, and usage-license lines ready to customize and download as a searchable PDF.

faq.question: Can I quote prints and albums separately?
faq.answer: Yes. Add print packages, albums, or travel as extra line items in the editor.

faq.question: Does this work for event and portrait shoots?
faq.answer: Yes. Change the descriptions and rates to match weddings, headshots, product, or events.

faq.question: Can I include a signature on the quote?
faq.answer: Yes. Draw or upload a signature in the editor before exporting the PDF. Use Accept quote when the client signs off.

title: Consulting Proposal Template
description: Build a consulting proposal PDF with discovery, strategy, and retainer lines prefilled. Free, private, and editable in your browser.

faq.question: Is this proposal a tax invoice?
faq.answer: No. It is a commercial proposal. Issue official tax invoices separately after payment or project completion.

faq.question: Can I show tax per line?
faq.answer: Yes. Each line item supports its own tax rate so retainers and workshops can differ.

faq.question: Is there a watermark on free proposals?
faq.answer: Free PDFs include a small credit line. Pro removes it. Every PDF also prints a quotation disclaimer.

title: Construction Estimate Template
description: Generate a construction estimate PDF with labour, materials, and contingency lines. Customize quantities and download instantly.

faq.question: Is an estimate legally binding?
faq.answer: That depends on your local rules and contract language. This tool creates a price estimate, not a tax invoice; add your terms in the notes field.

faq.question: Can I list materials and labour separately?
faq.answer: Yes. Use as many line items as you need for trades, materials, permits, and allowances.

faq.question: Will totals stay accurate with tax?
faq.answer: Yes. Line tax and discounts are calculated in whole cents so the PDF matches the preview.

title: Landscaping Quote Template
description: Free landscaping quote PDF with design, planting, and maintenance lines ready to edit. No account required.

faq.question: Can I quote seasonal maintenance?
faq.answer: Yes. Use quantity × monthly rate, or split spring and autumn visits into separate lines.

faq.question: Can clients accept this as a proposal?
faq.answer: Export the PDF and send it however you already work — email, drive, or print. Mark the quote Accepted when they sign off.

faq.question: Does this work on a phone?
faq.answer: Yes. The editor and these niche pages are mobile-friendly for on-site quoting.

title: Cleaning Service Quote Template
description: Quote cleaning work fast with recurring visit and deep-clean lines prefilled. Free searchable PDF, nothing uploaded.

faq.question: Can I quote weekly and monthly on one estimate?
faq.answer: Yes. Combine recurring visits and one-off deep cleans as separate line items.

faq.question: Can I save my business details?
faq.answer: Yes. In the editor you can remember your issuer profile on this device for the next quote.

faq.question: Is CSV export available?
faq.answer: Yes. Export your document data as CSV or JSON from the editor when you need records.

title: Plumbing Quote Template

faq.question: Can I use decimal hours for labour?
faq.answer: Yes. Quantity accepts decimals so 2.5 hours quotes correctly.

faq.question: Can I add emergency or after-hours rates?
faq.answer: Yes. Add a surcharge line or raise the labour unit price for the job.

faq.question: Will this work offline after the first load?
faq.answer: Once loaded, the app runs in the browser. A normal connection is needed for the first visit and for licence checks if you use Pro.

faq.question: Is MakeFastQuote only for freelancers?

faq.question: Can I include rush fees?
faq.answer: Add a rush or weekend line item before you send the quote PDF.

faq.question: Does the client need an account to open the PDF?
faq.answer: No. You send a normal PDF file. They open it in any reader.

faq.question: Are templates available for different looks?
